verdict.rationale: Support response-time guarantees and escalation paths are a fair question for a cloud hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of support tiers, guaranteed response times, or escalation procedures. The line "Run by Fly.io engineers, not chat bots" describes who staffs support, not any guaranteed response time or escalation path, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the guaranteed support response times and escalation paths for my plan tier
